content:
Last month, Anthropic announced plans to expand Claude Cowork from Mac to iPhone and iPad, starting with its most expensive paid plan.

Anthropic stated that as of today, Claude Cowork is now fully available across mobile and desktop platforms for all paid plans.

For details on the release of Anthropic's Claude Cowork mobile version, please click here.

Meanwhile, OpenAI has also launched its own solution, ChatGPT Work, which is also available on iPhone, iPad, Mac, and the web.

Make the most of your Apple products and do more.
